categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Touches src/test/fuzz/private_broadcast.cpp and carries the Private Broadcast label, testing transaction relay retry mechanisms.
categories.rationale: Strengthens the private broadcast fuzz target to verify that `GetStale()` returns all stale transactions rather than just valid ones. Mutant testing demonstrated that a regression prematurely breaking iteration would pass existing tests and leave transactions unretried.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Tests category explicitly excludes tests that pin the behavior of a specific area, redirecting them to that area instead.
categories.rationale: The change targets area-specific logic for private broadcast relay rather than general test framework or fuzzing harness infrastructure.
